title: Ziyarat of Hazrat Abbas
intro: The visitation of Abbas ibn Ali, remembering his loyalty to Imam Husayn and his sacrifice at Karbala.
description: Read Ziyarat of Hazrat Abbas with arabic text, transliteration and english meaning, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text: The noble Shaykh Ja`far ibn Qawlawayh al-Qummi has reported through a chain of authority that Abu-Hamzah al-Thumali reported Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) as saying: If you intend to visit the tomb of al-`Abbas ibn `Ali (peace be upon him) that lies on the bank of the River Euphrates opposite to al-Ha'ir, you should stop at the gate of the shed (precinct) and say these words:

blocks.transliteration: salamu allahi wa salamu mala'ikatihi almuqarrabina
blocks.english: Peace of Allah and peace of His favorite angels,
His commissioned prophets,
His righteous servants,
all the martyrs, and all the veracious (ones),

blocks.transliteration: walzzakiyatu alttayyibatu fima taghtadi wa taruhu
blocks.english: and also pure, true blessings that come and go,
be upon you, O son of the Commander of the Faithful.
I testify to you of submission (to the will of God), honest acceptance as true,
loyalty, and sincerity

blocks.arabic: لِخَلَفِ ٱلنَّبِيِّ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَآلِهِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِ
blocks.transliteration: likhalafi alnnabiyyi salla allahu `alayhi wa alihi almursali
blocks.english: to the descendant of the commissioned Prophet, Allah’s blessings be upon him and his Household,
the chosen grandson (of the Prophet),
the well knowledgeable guide (to the true religion),
the conveying successor,
and the wrongfully oppressed one.
So, Allah may reward you on behalf of His Messenger,
the Commander of the Faithful,
al-Hasan, and al-Husayn,
peace of Allah be upon them,
with the best reward
for your steadfastness, dedication (to the sake of God), and support (for the right party).
Very excellent be the reward of the eternal life.
Allah’s curse be on him who killed you.

blocks.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man jahila haqqaka
blocks.english: Allah’s curse be on him who ignored your position
and belittled your sanctity.

blocks.arabic: وَلَعَنَ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ حَالَ بَيْنَكَ وَبَيْنَ مَاءِ ٱلْفُرَاتِ
blocks.transliteration: wa la`ana allahu man hala baynaka wa bayna ma'i alfurati
blocks.english: Allah’s curse be on him who precluded you from having from the water of the Euphrates.
I testify that you were killed wrongfully

blocks.arabic: وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُنْجِزٌ لَكُمْ مَا وَعَدَكُمْ
blocks.transliteration: wa anna allaha munjizun lakum ma wa`adakum
blocks.english: and that Allah will verily fulfill His promise that He made with you.

blocks.arabic: جِئْتُكَ يَا بْنَ أَمِيرِ ٱلُمْؤْمِنينَ وَافِداً إِلَيْكُمْ
blocks.transliteration: ji'tuka yabna amiri almu'minina wafidan ilaykum
blocks.english: O son of the Commander of the Faithful, I have come to you to present myself before you.

blocks.transliteration: wa qalbi musallimun lakum wa tabi`un
blocks.english: My heart is submissive to you and is following you.
And I am your follower.
I am ready to support you
until Allah decides.
He is surely the best of all those who decide.
I am verily with you,
not with your enemy.

blocks.transliteration: inni bikum wa bi'iyabikum min almu'minina
blocks.english: I am one of those who believe in you and believe in your Return.

blocks.transliteration: wa biman khalafakum wa qatalakum min alkafirina
blocks.english: I also one of those who deny your opposites and killers.

blocks.arabic: قَتَلَ ٱللَّهُ أُمَّةً قَتَلَتْكُمْ بِٱلأَيْدِي وَٱلأَلْسُنِ
blocks.transliteration: qatala allahu ummatan qatalatkum bil-aidi wal-alsuni
blocks.english: Allah may kill the group who killed you with hands and tongues (by giving orders of killing you.)

blocks.text: You should then enter, throw yourself on the tomb, and say the following words:

blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O righteous servant (of Allah)

blocks.transliteration: almuti`u lillahi wa lirasulihi wa li'amiri almu'minina
blocks.english: and obedient to Allah, to His Messenger, to the Commander of the Faithful,

blocks.arabic: وَٱلحَسَنِ وَٱلحُسَيْنِ صَلَّىٰ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ وَسَلَّمَ
blocks.transliteration: walhasani walhusayni salla allahu `alayhim wa sallama
blocks.english: to al-Hasan, and to al-Husayn, peace and greetings of Allah be upon them.

blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka wa rahmatu allahi wa barakatuhu
blocks.english: Peace, Allah’s mercy, blessings,

blocks.transliteration: wa maghfiratuhu wa ridwanuhu wa `ala ruhika wa badanika
blocks.english: forgiveness, and gratifications be upon you, your soul, and your body.

blocks.arabic: أَشْهَدُ وَأُشْهِدُ ٱللَّهَ أَنَّكَ مَضَيْتَ عَلَىٰ مَا مَضَىٰ بِهِ ٱلبَدْرِيُّونَ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu wa ushhidu allaha annaka madayta `ala ma mada bihi albadriyyuna
blocks.english: I testify, and call Allah to witness, that you abided by the same course that was taken by the warriors of (the battle of) Badr
and the strivers for Allah’s sake
who sincerely served Him in the battlefields against His enemies,
did their bests for supporting His disciples,
and defended His intimate ones.
So, Allah may reward you the best,
the maximum,
the most abundant,

blocks.arabic: وَأَوْفَىٰ جَزَاءِ أَحَدٍ مِمَّنْ وَفَىٰ بِبَيْعَتِهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa awfa jaza'i ahadin mimman wa fa bibay`atihi
blocks.english: and the most conclusive reward that He may give to any one who fulfills his homage,
answers the call (of the religion),
and obeys his (divinely elected) leaders.

blocks.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ قَدْ بَالَغْتَ فِي ٱلنَّصِيحَةِ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu annaka qad balaghta fi alnnasihati
blocks.english: I testify that you acted extremely sincerely
and exerted all your efforts (in this regard).
Allah may attach you to the martyrs,

blocks.transliteration: wa ja`ala ruhaka ma`a arwahi alssu`ada'i
blocks.english: add your soul to the souls of the happy ones,

blocks.transliteration: wa a`taka min jinanihi afsahaha manzilan
blocks.english: give you the largest abode in His Paradise
and the most handsome room,
exalt your mention in `Illiyyin (the most elevated position),
and join you to the Prophets, the veracious ones,
the martyrs, and the righteous ones.
Very excellent is the companionship of such ones.

blocks.arabic: أَشْهَدُ أَنَّكَ لَمْ تَهِنْ وَلَمْ تَنْكُلْ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu annaka lam tahin wa lam tankul
blocks.english: I testify that you did not lag behind and did not turn away the face,

blocks.arabic: وَأَنَّكَ مَضَيْتَ عَلَىٰ بَصِيرَةٍ مِنْ أَمْرِكَ
blocks.transliteration: wa annaka madayta `ala basiratin min amrika
blocks.english: and that you left this life with full awareness of the truth,
following the examples of the righteous ones
and sticking to the Prophets.
So, Allah may gather us with you,
with His Messenger, and with His disciples
in the abodes of those who practiced humbly (with their Lord).
He is certainly the most merciful of all the merciful ones.

blocks.text:
According to the previously mentioned narration, the ziyarah of al-`Abbas ends here.
But Sayyid Ibn Tawus and Shaykh al-Mufid, as well as other scholars, have added the following: You may then turn to the side of the head and offer a two-unit prayer. Afterwards, you may offer prayers as many as you wish. See Next Tab -->

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت حضرت عباس علیہ السلام کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
